dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Emma, what do people in Canada do at Christmas?
dialogue.reading: ˈɛmə, ˈwʌt duː ˈpiːpəl ɪn ˈkænədə ˈduː ət ˈkrɪsməs?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Every year, my family buys a Christmas tree, and we give gifts to all our friends.
dialogue.reading: ˈɛvri ˈjɪr, maɪ ˈfæməli ˈbaɪz ə ˈkrɪsməs ˌtriː, ənd wiː ˈɡɪv ˈɡɪfts tə ˈɔːl aʊər ˈfrɛndz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Does every child get a gift from Santa Claus?
dialogue.reading: dʌz ˈɛvri ˈtʃaɪld ˈɡɛt ə ˈɡɪft frəm ˈsæntə ˌklɔːz?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes! All the children wait for Santa Claus on the night before Christmas.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs! ˈɔːl ðə ˈtʃɪldrən ˈweɪt fər ˈsæntə ˌklɔːz ɑːn ðə ˈnaɪt bɪˈfɔːr ˈkrɪsməs.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Are there fireworks at Christmas, too?
dialogue.reading: ər ðɛr ˈfaɪərwɜːrks ət ˈkrɪsməs, ˈtuː?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Not really. We have fireworks for the New Year. In big cities, people count down together.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈriːli. wiː ˈhæv ˈfaɪərwɜːrks fər ðə ˈnuː ˈjɪr. ɪn ˈbɪɡ ˈsɪtiz, ˈpiːpəl ˌkaʊnt ˈdaʊn təˈɡɛðər.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: We count down in Bangkok, too. Every year, I go to a big mall with my friends.
dialogue.reading: wiː ˌkaʊnt ˈdaʊn ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk, ˈtuː. ˈɛvri ˈjɪr, aɪ ˈɡoʊ tə ə ˈbɪɡ ˈmɔːl wɪð maɪ ˈfrɛndz.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Fun! My family just watches the fireworks on TV.
dialogue.reading: ˈfʌn! maɪ ˈfæməli ˈdʒʌst ˈwɑːtʃɪz ðə ˈfaɪərwɜːrks ɑːn ˌtiːˈviː.
